'''Jom Shomo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. He was a member of [[Rike's Raiders]], a unit led by a strong Republic loyalist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Amos Rike]]. Following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]] Empress [[Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]], Rike led his loyalists including Lieutenant Shomo to displace the Alliance forces on [[Denova]] and seize control of the Denovan [[Baradium Mine]]s. Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]] send a strike team to Denova to reclaim control of the mines. In the ensuing [[Assault on Denova|battle]], Shomo ambushed the Alliance forces, but was overwhelmed and eventually killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Jom Shomo appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a boss during the "Trench Runner" Uprising.
